visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male bodybuilder with a tanned, muscular physique poses on a dark stage. He wears black posing trunks. The background features a large grey screen with the 'WNBF TAIWAN' logo and vertical sponsor banners showing 'VERVE', 'COEGG', and 'TEMPOFUN'. Lighting is bright and directed towards the stage center. (2) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white textured jacket and a light green skirt, stands on the same stage holding a silver microphone. She holds up a white rectangular product package with her other hand, gesturing with excitement towards the audience. She has a bright, smiling facial expression. (3) The scene shifts to a crowded indoor hallway or lobby with wood-paneled walls and warm indoor lighting. Numerous people, some wearing masks, are walking around or looking at their smartphones. A table in the foreground holds disposable cups and bottles. (4) Back on the stage, the woman places a silver medal around the neck of the male bodybuilder. A group shot follows, showing five male bodybuilders standing in a row, all tanned and wearing colorful posing trunks, showcasing their medals and trophies. (5) The woman appears in a close-up, selfie-style shot, speaking directly to the camera in a room with soft lighting. Visual overlays appear on the screen, including a news report showing another woman in a pink bikini on a bodybuilding stage with text '台灣第一人' and a social media post with a 'like' icon.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-tempo electronic dance beat featuring a prominent synth bassline. A clear, male voiceover provides a brief narration in a professional, slightly excited tone. (2) A transition whoosh leads to a female voice speaking through a stage microphone; there is a noticeable hall reverb and echoes of a large space. Distant crowd cheering and enthusiastic applause are audible in the background. (3) The BGM shifts to a brighter, mid-tempo pop track. The female voice continues as narration, but the acoustic texture becomes drier. Background chatter and the soft rustle of movement in a public space can be heard. (4) A digital 'ding' sound effect marks a transition. The female voice returns to a studio-clear quality, speaking with high energy and a friendly, informal tone. The BGM remains as a consistent, upbeat rhythmic bed underneath the speech. (5) The video concludes with the music fading out over a final 'sparkle' sound effect, while the female voice expresses a warm closing sentiment.
